passages.text: Meals on business trips are reimbursed up to USD 75 per day. Meals with customers are reimbursed separately and require receipts.
Hotel stays are reimbursed up to USD 220 per night in major cities and USD 160 per night elsewhere.
Book economy class for domestic flights. Business class is allowed only for international flights longer than 8 hours.
Submit expense reports within 30 days after the trip, with receipts for any item over USD 25.
